title: ResourceQueueRepository
responsibility: Persists leases and telemetry and applies reservation decisions atomically across native processes.

inputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.constructor.home
inputs.description: The directory passed to resourceDatabase when opening the repository. Defaults to resourceHome() when omitted.

inputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.add.job
inputs.description: A ResourceJob without its sequence field, serialized into the resource_jobs table. The stored row's sequence is added when all() reads it.

inputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.patch.id
inputs.description: The ResourceJob id used to find the row to update. If no row matches, patch performs no write.

inputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.patch.changes
inputs.description: A partial ResourceJob merged over the matching stored job inside an immediate transaction. Missing ids are ignored, and the merged value is written without schema parsing here.

inputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.remove.id
inputs.description: The ResourceJob id used by the DELETE statement. A missing id deletes no row and is not reported.

inputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.schedule.sample
inputs.description: The host resource snapshot passed to resourcePolicy for this scheduling decision.

inputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.schedule.config
inputs.description: The ResourceConfig passed to resourcePolicy for this scheduling decision, containing CPU and memory reserve settings and telemetry timing limits.

inputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.schedule.now
inputs.description: The numeric time value passed to resourcePolicy for this scheduling decision. Defaults to Date.now() when omitted.

inputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.saveSnapshot.sample
inputs.description: The snapshot serialized into resource_state for the snapshot id. An older sample is skipped only when the stored sampledAt is at or before Date.now() and is later than this sample.

outputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.all
outputs.description: Rows ordered by ascending sequence, with each data JSON value combined with its row sequence and parsed by resourceJobSchema.

outputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.add
outputs.description: Returns no value after inserting the job id and serialized job data into resource_jobs.

outputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.patch
outputs.description: Returns no value after the matching job is updated; a missing id is a no-op.

outputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.remove
outputs.description: Returns no value after deleting rows whose id matches the input.

outputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.schedule
outputs.description: The jobs read in sequence order and updated from one resourcePolicy decision inside an immediate transaction; granted jobs become running with a null notice, and queued jobs receive a changed decision notice.

outputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.snapshot
outputs.description: The parsed snapshot stored under the snapshot id, or undefined when that row is absent. This method parses JSON but does not apply resourceJobSchema.

outputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.saveSnapshot
outputs.description: Returns no value after the atomic save, or after the timestamp guard skips the write.

outputs.name: ResourceQueueRepository.close
outputs.description: Returns no value after closing the repository's ResourceDatabase connection.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: A failure from ResourceDatabase or an atomic action propagates to the caller; atomic actions attempt rollback and rethrow the caught error.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: JSON.parse throws this when persisted job or snapshot data is not valid JSON.

errors.name: ZodError
errors.description: resourceJobSchema.parse throws this when persisted job data does not match the ResourceJob schema.
